column1: # Asset Import Template - Instructions and Column Descriptions
# This template is designed to match the Add Assets form fields.
# Please fill in the data below the header row and remove these comment lines before importing.
# IMPORTANT NOTES:
# - Required fields are marked with * in the column descriptions below
# - Leave cells empty for optional fields
# - Date format should be YYYY-MM-DD (e.g.
# - UIFID will be auto-generated automatically
# - GEM Contract Number must match an existing approved order
# COLUMN DESCRIPTIONS:
# GEM Contract Number*: Contract number from GEM portal (required) - Format: GEMC-511687759278412 or GEM/YYYY/B/XXXXXXX
# Name*: Asset name/title (required) - Example: "Dell Laptop Inspiron 15"
# Category*: Asset category (required) - Example: "Laptop"
# Serial Number*: Unique serial number (required) - Example: "DL123456789"
# Department: Department assignment - Example: "IT Department"
# Location: Physical location - Example: "Building A
# Model: Model number - Example: "Inspiron 15 3000"
# Manufacturer: Manufacturer name - Example: "Dell"
# Brand: Brand name - Example: "Dell"
# Condition: Asset condition - Options: "New"
# Description: Detailed description - Example: "15.6 inch laptop with Intel i5 processor"
# Value*: Asset value in ₹ (required) - Example: "45000" (numbers only
# Purchase Date*: Date of purchase (required) - Format: YYYY-MM-DD
# Warranty Expiry: Warranty expiration date - Format: YYYY-MM-DD
# Has AMC: AMC availability - Options: "Yes"
# AMC Expiry: AMC expiration date (if Has AMC = Yes) - Format: YYYY-MM-DD
# AMC Supplier Name: AMC service provider name (if Has AMC = Yes) - Example: "Tech Support Pvt Ltd"
# Status: Asset status - Options: "Active"
# Notes: Additional notes and comments - Example: "Previously used by John Doe"
